current_assessment.scope: Whether the natural-versus-rational appetite crux discriminates the purity family: mode (what fixes a favouring) versus formal object (what measures it), under one standard applied to both forms
current_assessment.assessment: The crux joins two coordinates. The purity family needs only the object coordinate: 05a4e794 reaches horn A's conclusion 7fca65ec from the per-bearer bridge 2306492a and the object premise f2e8eb42, neither of which mentions a mode, and the D-directed rival accepts the per-bearer measure and denies only f2e8eb42. Good-generality does not require the rational form: a good-general natural appetite satisfies the route's premises and the purity of good-generality and fails only the cognition criterion. Under the mode dichotomy and determination of the natural state to one end it does; at a root that premise states the cognition criterion's disputed step (d1fb6414), and the Fifth Way's first-source recognition stalls at the same point; this counts once. The kind rule makes rational mode sufficient, not necessary, for the object premise, so lane P's per-bearer cell 'natural (object D) versus rational (object the good)' is corrected to 'object D versus object the good'. ORIGINAL_FINALITY_2 at one pair gives good-generality, so commitment (e) in sense 2, lane P's common value standard and this route are one assumption. e2357adc remains open; its per-bearer warrant is f2e8eb42. Strongest standing rival: the D-directed nature as a natural appetite with object D (the Fifth Way's intrinsic directive nature at a root, D-directed form); price: denies f2e8eb42 and, given variation, must locate value (in its nature with an unrecorded fixity to D, independent, or produced). Relocation, not discrimination; no premise is established.
current_assessment.next_test: Where the value order is grounded for the D-rival, with the three loci priced; whether 'a nature's favouring follows the ordering its nature grounds' has warrant independent of E 9281317d; a root-level determination-to-one-end premise with simplicity as input; whether the classical root's apprehension of candidates is grounded in its self-apprehension (connecting the wisdom route to the apprehension state the fixer law requires). Per the three-angles rule, move horizontally unless one of these yields a new mode- or object-coordinate argument.
